entries.title: A crewmate waiting on its checks looks different
entries.body: When a crewmate is waiting for a pull request's checks, it still counts as working, but it glows a dimmer orange and turns slowly inside a thin blue ring. In Tasks, on the task board, in the summary and on the task's record, its dot is orange inside a blue ring, and its row in Tasks ends with "checks". It turns back to bright orange as soon as it starts working again.

picture.alt: A task in Tasks reading "Check the map · checks" with an orange dot inside a blue ring, and its summary beside it saying Working · Waiting for checks with checks running
